question: What is the meaning of warnings in relation to material health?
description: Warnings in relation to material health indicate substances that may pose risks to human health or the environment. These substances can be categorized as carcinogenic, mutagenic, toxic to reproduction, endocrine disruptors, toxic to a specific organ target, sensitive for respiration, or sensitive for skin. Additionally, substances that are persistent, bioaccumulative, and toxic (PBT) or very persistent and very bioaccumulative (vPvB) are also considered substances of concern. These warnings serve as a planning task to keep harmful substances out of buildings and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
